newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle Thursday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle Thursday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was rather slow on Thursday, with slaughter steers and heifers mostly $1.00 per cwt lower, USDA said. Inquiry fair, demand rather light.

Sales confirmed on 2,800 slaughter steers and 4,200 slaughter heifers Thursday. For the week to date 82,000 head confirmed including 31,700 head or about 39 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Select and Chhoice 2-3 1050-1200 lbs 67.00, few 67.50.
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1080 lbs 67.00, few 67.50; few mixed Commercial to Choice 1200 lb heifers and heiferettes 66.00.
Wk to date - 82,000 week ago - 97,600 year ago - 55,100
